# Service Automation

> Custom operations systems for home services businesses. We handle calls, quotes, follow-ups, reviews, reminders, websites, and campaigns — so owners can focus on doing the work.

## About
- Founded by Ryan, a small business owner in the East Bay, CA
- 25 years of experience building tools that make work easier
- Not a tech company — a one-person business helping other small business owners succeed

## Problems We Solve
- [Stop Missing Customer Calls](/stop-missing-customer-calls): Catch every call 24/7 without hiring an office manager
- [How to Follow Up on Quotes](/how-to-follow-up-on-quotes): Automated follow-ups at day 3 and 7 close more jobs
- [Get More Google Reviews](/get-more-google-reviews): Automatically ask every customer after every job
- [Keep Customers Coming Back](/keep-customers-coming-back): Recurring reminders and seasonal campaigns
- [How to Compete With Cheaper Contractors](/how-to-compete-with-cheaper-contractors): Win on quality and professionalism, not price
- [Automate Appointment Reminders](/automate-appointment-reminders): Reduce no-shows with automatic confirmations and reminders
- [How to Grow a Home Services Business](/how-to-grow-a-home-services-business): The complete playbook

## Who This Is For

Home services business owners with 1-50 employees who are great at the work but overwhelmed by the business operations side — managing calls, following up on quotes, keeping customers coming back, and handling paperwork.

## How It Works

1. We learn your business — services, pricing, customers, how you work.
2. We build a custom system tailored to your specific operations.
3. The system runs 24/7 in the background. You focus on the work.
